provenance.pipeline: satsuki v1 (v1.0.1 editorial re-edit: usage-note reshaping corpus-wide, lane discrimination for same-surface families, against prompts/style.md)

glosses: at; in; on (a place or time)
patterns.usage_note: Fixes an event to a point in space or time: where something exists or is put (駅の裏にある, 長野に住む) and clock times and dates (七時に起きる). Sibling lanes take a destination moved to (東京に戻る), the person told something (親に言う), and the one who can or knows (俺には分からない). Contrast で, which marks the arena an action goes on in (公園にいる vs 公園で遊ぶ). にゃ contracts には in speech and fiction dialogue, not in neutral prose.

examples.ruby: 駅[えき]の裏[うら]に小[ちい]さな古本屋[ふるほんや]がある。
examples.english: There's a little secondhand bookshop behind the station.

examples.ruby: 祖母[そぼ]は今[いま]も長野[ながの]に住[す]んでいる。
examples.english: My grandmother still lives in Nagano.

examples.ruby: 七時[しちじ]に目[め]が覚[さ]めてしまった。
examples.english: I ended up waking at seven.
